title: Report a down configured owner as unavailable for every owner-read dataset
decision: Unify on the dfb1b1a05 rule: a configured owner that is down reports unavailable for every owner-read dataset while an unconfigured owner reports missing; failing pools read no longer masks readable bindings source

production_fixes.change: CapitalPoolPort.get_surface_status always includes bindings_source even when pools read fails or is missing, preventing a failing pools read from masking a readable bindings source
ReadSurfacePorts.dataset_source returns status.get('source') for ranking and evolution datasets rather than turning status['status'] == 'unavailable' into missing

test_expectation_changes.decision: Task BFF-OWNER-READ-PROVENANCE-20261007 unifying on dfb1b1a05 rule. Configured owner that is down reports unavailable for all six cases (capital_pools, bindings, deployment_plans, runtime_bindings, evolution_programs, evolution_decisions). Changed expectations from 'missing' to 'unavailable' when owner call fails. Assertion tightened, not weakened.

new_tests.description: Verifies all 6 datasets report missing when owner URLs are unconfigured in environment
Verifies CapitalPoolPort with failing pools provider preserves readable bindings_source ('service')
Verifies ranking datasets report unavailable when downstream owner is down and missing when unconfigured

ac_1_configured_owner_down_reports_unava.detail: Every owner-read dataset (capital_pools, bindings, deployment_plans, runtime_bindings, evolution_programs, evolution_decisions, rankings, rebalances) reports unavailable when configured owner is down and missing when unconfigured.

ac_2_failing_pools_no_longer_masks_bindi.detail: CapitalPoolPort.get_surface_status returns bindings_source even when pools read fails; dataset_source('bindings') reports service when bindings_provider succeeds.

ac_3_all_tests_pass_no_regressions.detail: All 109 tests across test_receipt_default_reads.py, test_persona_capital_runtime_ports.py, test_ranking_evolution_projection_ports.py, test_owner_read_wiring.py, test_read_surface_port_cutover.py, and test_ranking_default_owner_integrity.py pass.

ac_4_test_expectation_changes_classified.detail: Changed expectation in test_receipt_default_reads.py classified as intended change under dfb1b1a05 unification. No assertion weakened to go green.

ac_5_budget_compliance_no_compressed_cod.detail: Production code net change is +1 line (+10 / -9), strictly within net_prod_line_budget: 20 without compressed code.
